english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for apparel and clothes in general.
Use this more general term when you want to refer explicitly to clothing rather than the everyday catch-all 衫.

examples.english: I bought some new clothes today.
examples.traditional: 我今日買咗幾件新衣服。

examples.english: Before the trip, remember to pack the garment.
examples.traditional: 去旅行前，記得帶件衣服。
